businesses.business: regulated electric and natural gas utility

offering_description.value: Generates, transmits and distributes electricity and delivers natural gas through regulated utility networks, selling mainly to homes, businesses and public agencies in the Pacific Northwest and Alaska.

primary_services.value: energy transmission and distribution; service connections

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households; B2B: commercial and industrial businesses; B2G: municipalities and public agencies

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated rates for electricity and natural gas delivered to customers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs power generation, transmission and distribution networks, sells energy to end customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Washington, Idaho, Oregon and Alaska

specialization.value: niche specialist: electric and natural gas utility service

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct service to residential and business accounts; online: online billing and account portal

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility commissions in WA, ID, OR and AK, and FERC for wholesale power sales

notes: Describes the regulated utility businesses; smaller affiliated nonutility activities are not separately described.
